title: 第3章 女妖第4章 山海图
content_zh:
女子的话毫无顾忌，张楚以及枣叶村的人，都听了个清清楚楚。
这一刻，小村里的人顿时都意识到，她们不是好人。
眨眼间，三个少女便踩着芦苇叶舟冲入了小村。
笼罩在小村上方的光幕，竟然没有阻拦她们，她们径直落在了小村中央。
村民们挡在了老枣树面前，每个人的眼神中都充满了戒备。
老村长先是微微摆手，示意村民们不要妄动。
紧接着，老村长出面，开口道：“三位仙子，不知道来我们小村，有什么事？”
一个少女直接说道：“这紫星枣木不错，我要了！”
村民们一听，顿时怒发冲冠，许多人顿时想动手，想要老枣树，这是要所有人的命！
此刻，老村长强忍着怒意说道：“这枣树是我们村的守护神，我们不卖，几位请离开！”
那个少女顿时笑了：“卖？谁告诉你们，我要买了？”
另一个少女也哼道：“和这些贱民废什么话，直接伐了就是！”
“你们敢！”老村长顿时一步上前，脖子通红。
张楚也目光发寒：“孩子后退，猎人队，准备迎敌！”
童青山立刻抽出长枪，周围，所有猎人队也动手，弯弓的弯弓，抽刀的抽刀，气氛瞬间紧张了起来。
然而，三个少女却并没有把这些村民放在眼中，一个少女忽然笑了：“咯咯咯，这些村民真是太有趣了，竟然敢阻拦我们！”
另一个少女，则笑眯眯的盯着所有人，她微微张嘴，伸出一根狭长的猩红舌头……
“嘶——”枣叶村的人见状，顿时都亡魂皆冒，浑身冰凉。
几个孩子甚至哇的一声哭出来：“哇……妖怪！”
张楚也一阵窒息，忍不住看向了三个少女的影子。

其中一个少女的影子后面，竟然隐约有条尾巴！
“果然是妖！”张楚倒吸了一口冷气！
周围，枣叶村的村民们，也发现了这一点，有人吓得手脚冰凉，双腿发颤。
在妖墟有一种说法，妖入村，大难临！
此刻，张楚以及所有村民的脑海中，涌现出无数关于妖的恐怖传闻。
不说远的，单单就这几年，已经发生过好几次妖入村的事情了。
两年前，距离枣叶村一百二十里之外，有一个村子，叫玉匣村。
某日，玉匣村进了妖，听说是个蝙蝠妖，仅仅一个白天，所有人的血都被吸干。
据说，连他们村的守护神，一个玉匣子，都被吸干了精华，风一吹，就散了。
还有四个月前，某个人类密集的小镇，名叫大孤镇，一群人想要除掉附近的银骨妖，因为那个银骨妖总是杀人。
结果，他们惹恼了银骨妖。
一日之间，银骨妖把大孤镇变成了一座“白骨城”。
所有人，无论是老人还是孩子，无论是青壮还是女人，都变成了白骨。
就连大孤镇的守护神，一座奇山，也被弄的千疮百孔，成了妖洞。
content_en:
The woman's words had no scruples, and Zhang Chu and the people in Zaoye Village heard them clearly.
At this moment, everyone in the small village suddenly realized that they were not good people.
In the blink of an eye, three girls rushed into the small village on reed boats.
The light curtain that shrouded the small village did not stop them, and they landed directly in the center of the small village.
The villagers stood in front of the old jujube tree, and everyone's eyes were full of wariness.
The old village chief waved his hand slightly to signal the villagers not to act rashly.
Immediately afterwards, the old village chief came forward and said: "Three fairies, what do you want to do when you come to our small village?"
A girl said directly: "This purple star jujube tree is good, I want it!"
When the villagers heard this, they immediately became furious. Many people immediately wanted to take action and want the old jujube tree. This would cost everyone's life!
At this moment, the old village chief suppressed his anger and said: "This jujube tree is the patron saint of our village. We will not sell it. Please leave!"
The girl suddenly laughed: "Selling? Who told you that I want to buy it?"
Another girl also hummed: "What nonsense are you talking to these untouchables? Just cut them down!"
"How dare you!" The old village chief stepped forward immediately, his neck red.
Zhang Chu also had cold eyes: "Children, retreat, hunter team, prepare to meet the enemy!"
Tong Qingshan immediately drew his spear, and all the hunting teams around him also took action, bending their bows and drawing their swords, and the atmosphere instantly became tense.
However, the three girls did not take these villagers seriously. One girl suddenly laughed: "Giggle, these villagers are so interesting, they dare to stop us!"
The other girl stared at everyone with a smile. She opened her mouth slightly and stuck out a long and narrow scarlet tongue...
"Hiss——" When the people in Zaoye Village saw this, their souls suddenly shivered and their whole bodies became cold.
A few children even cried out: "Wow... monster!"
Zhang Chu was also suffocated and couldn't help but look at the shadows of the three girls.
There is a faint tail behind the shadow of one of the girls!
"It's indeed a demon!" Zhang Chu gasped!
The surrounding villagers in Zaoye Village also discovered this. Some people were so frightened that their hands and feet were cold and their legs were trembling.
There is a saying in the demon market that when demons enter the village, disaster will come!
At this moment, countless terrifying rumors about demons emerged in the minds of Zhang Chu and all the villagers.
Not to mention, in the past few years alone, demons have entered the village several times.
Two years ago, there was a village one hundred and twenty miles away from Zaoye Village called Yuxi Village.
One day, a demon entered Yuxi Village. I heard it was a bat demon. In just one day, everyone's blood was sucked dry.
It is said that even the jade box, the patron saint of their village, was drained of its essence and scattered when the wind blew.
Four months ago, in a densely populated town called Dagu Town, a group of people wanted to get rid of the nearby silver-bone demon because the silver-bone demon always killed people.
As a result, they pissed off the Silver Bone Demon.
In one day, the Silver Bone Demon turned Dagu Town into a "City of Bones".
Everyone, old and young, young and old, was turned into bones.
Even the patron saint of Dagu Town, a strange mountain, was riddled with holes and turned into a monster cave.
